description: Manage agent tracking sessions and multi-turn workflow attribution. Supported actions: start (begin tracked session), end (conclude session), list (view active/historical sessions), bootstrap (single-turn start + context snapshot + next tasks).

action.description: The session management action to execute.

active_only.description: Whether to return only active unclosed sessions on list.

agent_id.description: Agent identifier for session tracking and change attribution.

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to list (1-1000).

task_limit.description: Maximum runnable tasks to return on bootstrap.

name: manage_sessions
